verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework, so a built-in command-execution and file-editing surface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows generic custom tools that a developer could use to build such a capability. A passing mention of 'Mastra Code' running on the same harness does not document any shell exec or file-edit capability.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can run commands and edit files on my machine — a real exec surface, not just chat about what to do
